agent_note: First-person retrospective narration, clean past-tense event core (18 past / 2 present). Quotation marks survive on only 3 quotes, so dialogue was identified mainly by vocatives ('Ana', 'Lucian'), direct address, and speech markers ('what I speak of', 'You said'); recorded per quote. Heavy aphorism load (11 gnomic) is exactly the quotability bias METHODOLOGY warns about. The two present event quotes (q05326, q05328) are narrating-present commentary by the retrospective narrator, not a simultaneous strand. q05346 discarded as author's note.
